goal: ImageNet-1K top1 >= 80%; prioritize original student fixed50 cost, report extra-cost solutions separately
scope: Exploratory reuse of existing calibration/holdout split; neither split is claimed new untouched confirmation

families: fixed ratio .25/.50/.75/.90/1.0 with variable exit gate
monotone exit -> .25 -> .50 -> .75 with three ordered grid boundaries
objectives: highest calibration accuracy within original fixed50 cost
cache_search.selection: calibration only, save policies before reporting holdout; deterministic cost/accuracy/parameter tie breaks

finetune.checkpoint_selection: final epoch only; choose between two variants on calibration labels before inspecting holdout summaries

policies: gate calibrated without labels to 100% of original fixed50 cost
gate calibrated without labels to 98% of original fixed50 cost
evaluation.primary: best calibrated variant at 98% training cost, evaluated against original 100% cost ceiling
evaluation.limits: Point accuracy >=80 does not imply a population accuracy lower bound >=80. Additional cost never counted as same-budget success. Analytic MAC excludes selection overhead.
